description.en: The name of the business monitoring job.

description.zh:
使用场景。选项：

- `USER-DEFINED`（默认）：用户自定义。
- `EDAS-ROLLOUT`：EDAS应用发布。
- `OAM-ROLLOUT`：OAM应用发布。
- `MSC-CANARY`：MSE金丝雀发布。
description.en:
The scenario where the business monitoring job is used. Valid values:

*   `USER-DEFINED`: user-defined. This is the default value.
*   `EDAS-ROLLOUT`: application release in Enterprise Distributed Application Service (EDAS)
*   `OAM-ROLLOUT`: application release based on Open Application Model (OAM)
*   `MSC-CANARY`: canary release based on Microservice Engine (MSE)

description.zh: 场景编码，明确知道目标业务场景编码时设置。
description.en: The code of the business monitoring job. Set this parameter when you know the code of the business monitoring job you want to query.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun arms list-scenario --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --scenario USER-DEFINED --name '测试业务监控' --app-id b590lhguqs@28f515462000000 --sign a9f80000 --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun arms ListScenario --region cn-hangzhou --AppId 'b590lhguqs@28f515462000000' --Sign a9f80000 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Scenario 'USER-DEFINED' --Name '测试业务监控'
